title: Column audience picker
description: A lime mono eyebrow over a full-width hairline, then a stack of big 40px audience names in soft grey: the chosen one sits in a raised white pill with its icon, in dark ink. Two paragraphs about that audience follow and crossfade when you pick another. A tall art slot with a soft halo fills the right side on desktop.
notes: needs JavaScript to switch audiences (hydrate: visible); without it the first one stays chosen
media fills the 448×600 art slot (desktop only, like the original); empty, it's a soft highlight wash with a faint dot grid
